title: Scoring With the Engine: Retrieval Exposure, Cross-Engine Divergence, and the Limits of Engine-Agnostic GEO Scores
abstract: arXiv:2609.22655v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent work asks whether generative-engine visibility can be approximated with deterministic, engine-free page scores. We separate two stages such scores can conflate: exposure to a live engine and citation selection conditional on exposure. In an observational audit of ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Google, and Perplexity, 15 fixed commercial prompts produced 589 citation observations on 6 June 2026, corresponding to 528 unique URLs and 356 domains. Same-prompt cross-engine URL overlap was extremely small: mean pairwise Jaccard similarity was 0.0079, the median was zero, and 84.9% of engine pairs shared no cited URL. On the ten prompts observed on all four engines, mean exact-URL Jaccard was 0.0072. A matched-size hypergeometric baseline preserving each prompt's four-engine URL universe and each engine's list length predicts 0.1272, so observed overlap was only 5.7% of that baseline; zero URL overlap occurred in 86.7% of comparisons versus

translated_title: 引擎内评分：检索曝光、跨引擎分歧与引擎无关GEO评分的局限性
translated_abstract: 近期研究探讨生成式引擎的可见性是否可以用确定性的、与引擎无关的页面评分来近似。我们区分了这类评分可能混淆的两个阶段：对真实引擎的检索曝光，以及在曝光条件下的引用选择。在对ChatGPT、Microsoft Copilot、Google和Perplexity的观察性审计中，15个固定的商业提示词于2026年6月6日产生了589条引用观察，对应528个唯一URL和356个域名。相同提示词下跨引擎的URL重叠极小：平均成对Jaccard相似度仅为0.0079，中位数为零，84.9%的引擎对之间没有共享任何被引用的URL。在所有四个引擎上都观察到的十个提示词上，平均精确URL Jaccard为0.0072。一个保持每个提示词的四引擎URL全集和每个引擎列表长度的匹配规模超几何基线预测值为0.1272，因此观察到的重叠仅为该基线的5.7%；86.7%的比较中出现零URL重叠。
tldr: 该研究通过对四大生成式引擎的观察性审计发现，相同提示词下不同引擎引用的URL重叠仅为随机基线的5.7%，表明与引擎无关的确定性页面评分无法有效预测生成式引擎的引用可见性。
en_tdlr: Through an observational audit of four generative engines, this study finds that cross-engine URL overlap for identical prompts is only 5.7% of a random baseline, demonstrating that engine-agnostic deterministic page scores cannot effectively predict citation visibility in generative engines.
